cause: The v1.7 classifier treated blue hues in the decoded heightfield as ocean. The heightfield is an elevation visualization, and low-elevation land can also be blue; RGB hue alone is not a valid sea mask.
vanilla_maps: Restored the pre-v1.7 coordinate-registered vanilla maps.
warsails_terrain: Re-rendered from the original War Sails highfield panel cropped at pixels [1227,83,2003,859], 776x776. No guessed ocean mask was applied; its raw elevation palette must not be read as a binary land/sea classification.
warsails_water: Restored the pre-v1.7 navmesh water-group map without palette reclassification. This is a separate navigation-water evidence layer, not the land-sea mask for the terrain raster.
remaining_work: A shared soft palette requires a validated, version-specific land/sea mask. Do not infer sea from elevation hue or use the War Sails navmesh water polygons as an unverified substitute for the terrain mask.
